relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of TRPV1 receptors excites primary afferent nociceptors by opening cation channels, allowing the influx of Na<sup>+</sup> and Ca<sup>2+</sup> ions into the cytoplasm.

key_findings: A TRPV1 knockout human ES cell line was generated by CRISPR/Cas9 with normal pluripotency and karyotype.
